s1.syndrome_frame: Acute monocular vision loss with associated orbital and adnexal inflammation
salient_findings: Pain, numbness, and erythematous induration of the eyelids and forearm
Tense eyelid edema, chemosis, and corneal haze
Serous retinal detachment and macular whitening
key_facts: Patient is an obese man in his mid-30s
No prior systemic or ocular disorders
Heavy alcohol consumption and buprenorphine/naloxone use the night prior
Denies any trauma
Visual acuity is no light perception in the right eye and 20/20 in the left eye
Intraocular pressure is 37 mm Hg in the right eye and 21 mm Hg in the left eye
Creatinine level is 2.2 mg/dL
Creatine kinase level is 29,320 U/L
Periorbital soft-tissue swelling on noncontrast computed tomography
Severe disorganization of the retinal architecture on Optical Coherence Tomography
Delayed choroidal filling and poor vascular perfusion on Fluorescein Angiography

shortlist.label: Central Retinal Artery Occlusion
shortlist.why_kept: sudden vision loss, no light perception in one eye, and retinal findings on imaging

shortlist.label: Posterior Scleritis
shortlist.why_kept: orbital and adnexal inflammation, elevated intraocular pressure, and retinal detachment

shortlist.label: Giant Cell Arteritis
shortlist.why_kept: acute monocular vision loss, orbital inflammation, and elevated creatine kinase level

shortlist.label: Orbital Cellulitis
shortlist.why_kept: periorbital soft-tissue swelling, erythematous induration, and vision loss

shortlist.label: Purtscher retinopathy
shortlist.why_kept: vision loss, retinal findings, and recent history of heavy alcohol consumption and buprenorphine/naloxone use

raw.rationale: The patient's history of heavy alcohol consumption and buprenorphine/naloxone use, combined with the sudden onset of vision loss, pain, and retinal findings such as severe disorganization of the retinal architecture and serous retinal detachment, are consistent with Purtscher retinopathy, a condition associated with trauma, head injury, or other forms of systemic distress.

rejected.label: Central Retinal Artery Occlusion
rejected.why: While the patient has vision loss and retinal findings, the presence of systemic symptoms such as creatine kinase level elevation and periorbital soft-tissue swelling suggests a more complex condition than a simple retinal artery occlusion.

rejected.label: Posterior Scleritis
rejected.why: The patient's presentation lacks the characteristic pain and tenderness to the globe that is typical of posterior scleritis, and the imaging findings do not specifically support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Giant Cell Arteritis
rejected.why: The patient's age and lack of prior systemic or ocular disorders make this diagnosis less likely, and the presence of heavy alcohol consumption and buprenorphine/naloxone use points towards a different etiology.

rejected.label: Orbital Cellulitis
rejected.why: While the patient has periorbital soft-tissue swelling, the primary issue appears to be related to the retina and vision, rather than an orbital infection.
